name: alynki-sealed
description: Alynki — the business context layer, sealed: a local component decrypts context on this machine

token.title: Alynki API token (optional — leave blank to sign in instead)
token.description: Issued to you by your Alynki operator. Leave this blank to sign in with your own identity instead: run `alynki-local login` once per machine.

key.title: Alynki organisation key (optional — set once via alynki-local key import)
key.description: Your organisation's content key (base64url). It stays on this machine and is never sent to Alynki. Leave this blank and run `alynki-local key import` once instead — the key then lives in this machine's own credential store rather than in this plugin's configuration.

key_id.title: Alynki key id (optional — set once via alynki-local key import)
key_id.description: The id of your organisation key, issued alongside it. Leave this blank if you imported the key with `alynki-local key import`.
